name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: Set up or join your club right from the welcome screen.  Club forms keep your draft on this phone, show a problem right beside the box, and explain who can be given a role.
When you add someone to the member list, Paid up starts unticked.  Tick it only when they've paid.
Bringing in a member list from Excel shows each row's number from the sheet and sorts people into new, updated, unchanged and left out.  Dates stay the day written in the sheet.
When you reuse a saved import setup, check the name column.  If names are written Last, First, tick whether to turn them round.
Pick a time from the list or type your own.  Your club's meeting day is kept on this phone for now.
Home puts Inspect a hive, My hives and today's to-dos up front. Find Settings, Getting started and other tools in More.
Try the colorful honeycomb Home with New Home (try it) in Settings. It starts off. See all groups due work by yard.
Bigger, clearer tile pictures on Home
If you dismiss the microphone prompt, Talk switches off and tells you Wingman needs the microphone. You can still type.
Let Buddy finish the question and wait until the screen says Listening before answering.  If you hear a beep, let it finish too.  An answer started too soon can be missed.
Say "nothing" when Buddy asks what needs doing next time. Any task you already entered stays in place. "Bring gloves" stays in the notes.
Buddy keeps the bee sample size you say with a mite count, asks again after an off-topic queen answer, and checks which hive you meant before a split.

In a long hive, Buddy repeats the brood-frame count before asking how much brood you saw. When you say you put in a new marked queen in a cage, review how she'll be released before setting her checks.
Settings has shorter explanations, fuller help under ?, and search that finds switches by name.
If you're signed out, Wingman can offer a backup after your third saved inspection. Canceling a restore keeps your photos and recordings.
Care and My club tabs open at the top. Club role confirmations show what the club has on record, or say if it couldn't be confirmed.
